image_description: A close-up shot of a small juvenile guenon monkey being held in human hands. The monkey has golden-orange fur on its head, a dark face with a white ruff around the cheeks and chest, and dark limbs. It is clutching a small yellow object. The background shows a window frame and blurred outdoor greenery.

The nose structure is narrow and typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are visible, small, and partially hidden by head fur, matching the description.

Check if the fingers are anatomically distinct or if they merge into the object or each other.
